title: Barcelona yacht ride
text: We had a wonderful experience on our yacht ride! Dani was an amazing skipper!
author: 55makaylaz

title: Brilliant afternoon on board with Dani
text: We had an amazing afternoon. Dani, the skipper was brilliant - everything was easy: finding the boat and getting briefed/underway; the boat was very smart and clean, with lovely space to chill out. Food and drinks were great (and plentiful) and Dani took us to a lovely swimming area and set us up for all of that with shower/towels/ladder/paddleboard etc. We honestly had the best time and I would highly recommend it. Viator made booking and paying very easy, and the instructions/tickets etc. were excellent. Super, thank you!
author: Carrie_D

title: Once in a lifetime boat trip to remember.
text: Wonderful experience! We booked the charter yacht La Gavina, a beautiful boat and had an incredible day on the Mediterranean. Dani the captain was so professional and knowledgeable. He laid out quite the spread for us with tapas, cava, and beer. It was definitely an experience we will remember forever!
author: Andrea_B

title: Magical experience!!!!
text: All simply wonderful!!!! The service of the crew and the boat impeccable!!!! One of the best experiences I've ever had.
author: Renata B

title: LA partners cruising
text: Sea was choppy that day however captain Dani did a great job and our group had a fantastic time learning about the area and swimming in the ocean. It was an awesome experience. Would do it again for sure. Thanks captain Dani

title: Sunset Cruise
text: We enjoyed a romantic sunset cruise, and captain Dani was amazing! Leading up to the cruise, he was in constant contact setting up the food and drinks we wanted for the cruise. The boat itself is in great condition and a perfect way to spend a few hours out on the water.

title: Incredibles

title: Fun and relaxing day
text: Dani was great and the boat was very nice! He served us some little snacks and cava. Such a relaxing day on the water, we wish we would have booked a longer day!
